about.title: About Me
about.bio1: Hello! My name is Victor, I'm a Software Engineering student, currently in my fourth semester, and I have a great passion for creating simple, intuitive, and effective solutions to complex problems.
about.bio2: My programming journey began in 2023 at the Federal University of Bahia (UFBA), where I had my first contact with C++. During this period, I solved several computational problems that helped me consolidate fundamental programming concepts such as logic, control structures, basic data structures, and problem-solving.
about.bio3: After this beginning, I joined FIAP - Faculdade de Informática e Administração Paulista, where, already in the first year, I deepened my knowledge in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python. During this period, I participated in several group projects, acting as organizer and leader, which significantly contributed to the development of technical and behavioral skills such as teamwork, communication, and technical leadership.
about.bio4: Still in my first year of college, I was approved for a training program at AOOP (An NTT Data Company). Since then, I have been promoted twice in the same year, currently working as a Junior Technical Consultant III, a position in which I continue to develop my professional and technical skills in the daily corporate environment.
about.bio5: My professional commitment is directly linked to my moral principles and my faith in God. I believe that my purpose is to use technology as a tool to positively impact the lives of thousands of people, creating applications that generate real value and contribute to the development of society.
